subtitle: Operating data, OEM limits, and field context combined to support risk-based decisions on aging process equipment.
objective: Assess fatigue risk and monitoring gaps for brazed aluminum heat exchangers using historical operating data and OEM-prescribed operating limits.
context: The equipment supports facility operations, so the analysis had to connect historical process behaviour with inspection planning and practical operational awareness.
contribution: Extracted process data with the PI Historian Excel add-in and developed Python screening tools for thermal ramp rates, cyclic operation limits, and parting-sheet temperature distributions.

decision.label: ENGINEERING DECISION
decision.title: Use measured operating behaviour to focus the next action.
decision.text: The work connected process data with failure mechanisms and monitoring coverage. Recommendations included additional instrumentation where coverage was insufficient and reduced actuated-valve opening rates to limit turbulent flow and erosion on the inner pipe face.

results: Analyzed 2+ years of operating data across 12+ brazed aluminum heat exchangers.
Compiled lifecycle findings to support risk-based decisions, inspection planning, and operating awareness.

figures.caption: Figure 03 — Field context for the asset data. Engineering analysis is stronger when it remains connected to the equipment, inspection work, and operating decisions it supports.
